module: Flowgraph module (moduleOrder 0) that wraps gameplay_traffic and gameplay_parking for traffic nodes. It remembers whether the flowgraph itself enabled traffic (trafficActive) or parked cars (parkedCarsActive) so as to disable them on stop only if it enabled them, unless keepTrafficState is true.
notes: On stop (without keepTrafficState), if traffic was active, it resets the traffic and pursuit variables (setTrafficVars, setPursuitVars) and the parking ones, then disables traffic and parked cars.
keepTrafficState is set back to false on every stop.

init.desc: Called when the module is created: trafficActive, parkedCarsActive and keepTrafficState are false.

updateTrafficState.desc: Updates trafficActive from gameplay_traffic.getTrafficData(). Use only if the flowgraph changed the traffic state.

insertTraffic.desc: Adds a vehicle to the traffic (gameplay_traffic.insertTraffic) and updates the state.

removeTraffic.desc: Removes a vehicle from the traffic (gameplay_traffic.removeTraffic) and updates the state.

activateTraffic.desc: Enables traffic (gameplay_traffic.activate) with a list of vehicles.

deactivateTraffic.desc: Disables traffic (gameplay_traffic.deactivate), only if it was enabled by the flowgraph.

deactivateParkedCars.desc: Disables parked cars (processVehicles without arguments), only if enabled by the flowgraph.

executionStopped.desc: Called when the project stops: resets the traffic, pursuit and parking variables then disables traffic and parked cars, unless keepTrafficState is true.
